title: 📚 Past Tense (Imperfect - लङ् लकार)
description: Learn to talk about past actions using the imperfect tense.

sections.title: 📖 Imperfect Tense (Past - लङ्)
sections.content: The imperfect tense is used for past actions that happened recently or in the past. In English, it's like 'was doing' or 'did'.

examples.अहम्: अहं विद्यालयं अगच्छम्। (I went to school.)
examples.सः: सः वनम् अगच्छत्। (He went to the forest.)

questions.question: How do you say 'I went' in Sanskrit?
questions.explanation: 'अगच्छम्' (agaccham) is the imperfect form of 'I went'.

questions.question: How do you say 'He read' in Sanskrit?
Translate: 'अहं फलम् अखादम्।'
questions.explanation: 'अखादम्' (akhādam) is the past tense form of 'to eat'.
